summary: This chunk adds grading and output artifacts for the debug-loop skill's 'pasted-traceback' eval (with_skill config). grading.json records all 5 expectations passed: a debug brief before edits, reproduction of the KeyError, identification of a UTF-8 BOM as root cause, a BOM-aware fix (utf-8-sig), and a regression test. metrics.json logs 17 tool calls and 2 errors. A new project subproject (git submodule) is added. response.md is the full debug-brief transcript: diagnosing that report.py's utf-8 decode leaves a BOM glued to the header key 'region', fixing it with encoding='utf-8-sig', adding a failing-then-passing regression test, and revert-verifying the fix.

claims.text: All 5 grading expectations passed for the with_skill pasted-traceback eval
Root cause is that report.py opened the CSV with encoding='utf-8', which does not strip a byte-order mark, so the header key becomes '\ufeffregion' and row['region'] raises KeyError
Fix changes report.py's open() call from encoding='utf-8' to encoding='utf-8-sig', a one-line change
A regression test using tests/data/bom.csv was added, shown failing before the fix and passing after, and re-verified red on revert
metrics.json reports 17 total tool calls (8 Bash, 3 Read, 2 Edit, 4 Write) and 2 errors_encountered
The eval's project output is stored as a git submodule reference (mode 160000, subproject commit b1d14f7...), not inline file diffs
An unrelated .gitignore addition (untracking __pycache__/.pytest_cache) was made alongside the fix and flagged to the reviewer as optional to drop

risks.note: total_by_region will still raise a raw KeyError on other header drift (renamed/missing amount column), explicitly left unfixed.
'errors_encountered': 2 is stated with no detail in this chunk on what those two errors were.
